rules.title: Rules
rules.goal: Goal: Bring all 15 checkers into your home board (bottom right), then bear them off. The first to bear off all checkers wins.
rules.move: Moving: Each die is a move of its own. A double counts twice, so you play the number four times. You may move to empty points, to your own points and to points with only one opposing checker.
rules.hit: Hitting: A single checker can be hit and goes to the bar. From there it has to re-enter in the opponent’s home board before anything else may move.
rules.must: Obligation: You must use as many dice as possible. If only one fits, it has to be the higher one.
rules.bear: Bearing off: Only once all your checkers are in your home board. With a higher number you may bear off from the rearmost occupied point.
rules.score: Scoring: A single game is worth 1 point. If the opponent has not borne off any checker, it is a gammon worth 2 points. If one of their checkers is then still on the bar or in your home board, it is a backgammon worth 3 points.
